description.en: Certificates, contracts, source documents and verification tasks in one administration desk.
description.zh-CN: 统一管理证照、合同、原件来源和待核验事项。

agentPrompts:
Review certificates and administrative contracts expiring within 60 days and draft an owner-by-owner renewal plan.
检查 60 天内到期的证照和行政合同，按负责人拟定续期计划。

Compare original-document dates with archive summaries and prepare verification tasks without resolving conflicting evidence by guesswork.
比较原件日期与归档汇总，拟定核验待办，不凭猜测处理证据冲突。
